item.title: Adding Collaboration Tag
item.content:encoded:
Hello all! Long time no see.

I intended this to always be an Experiment log that was welcome to additions of others, but I suppose I was never really forthright about that.

So, I am adding the collaboration tag to this at the suggestion of /u/agentCDE on Reddit. So, feel free to think of more rituals (or revise the final one to something that has a little more common sense.)

Do note, though, that I will request edits or remove any that don't necessarily follow the rules of the SCP and/or don't make much sense. But feel free to give it a shot! :D

Also, if you can't get a hang of the formatting but would still like to add one, feel free to post it here of message it to me and I can add it in and give credit to you.

item.title: Re: Experiment-2105-α3
item.content:encoded: For spelling and grammar and that sort of thing, you can edit an article. If it's a major change, you should run it by the author (where a minor change becomes major can be subjective. If you're not sure, there's no harm in double checking with the author). In this case, I'd say that's probably a fine change to make.
